items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: So everybody on the train is gambling-- Velma Middleton, Humph. M. HILLIARD; Shelton Simmons Sonny Woods... Louis Russell was in it, too.

ctx.x: in Montreal. He's going to make this tour to the West Coast and come back. Quit the band and go to Montreal and marry.

So everybody on the train is gambling-- Velma Middleton, Humph. M. HILLIARD; Shelton Simmons Sonny Woods, what's his name, yeah, and someone else. Always played poker. Velma and Sonny Woods always won. Louis Russell was in it, too.

So somehow, Prince Robinson lost his traveler's checkbook. He got up -- we had broken the train down completely level. Everything was a bed except the back of the train. The back of the seats, we had just uncovered them and let them down, you know. So Prince turned snow white overnight, his hair. Honest to God. His hair wasn't grey, it had, you know, tinges of grey, and the next day it was almost snow white. Worried him to death. Someone found it and was playing games on him. And they finally give it back to him.…
